labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Campaign Sync grants
labels.value: Edit an appeal's Campaign ID and open the Campaign sync page. Creating Campaigns also needs Campaign access and the Marketing User box on the person's user.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Opportunity Mirror grants
labels.value: Edit a gift's Opportunity ID and open the Opportunity mirror page. Creating Opportunities also needs Opportunity access.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Accounting Export grants
labels.value: Download gifts as a CSV file for your accounting system and mark them posted. Give it together with a Giving permission set that reads gifts.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Inbound Gift API grants
labels.value: For the integration user only: record gifts another system sends through the Inbound Gift API. It needs nothing else from BarnCRM.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Record Inbound Gift Action grants
labels.value: Run the Record Inbound Gift action from a flow or an AI assistant. Give it together with Giving Staff.
